title: Specialization: Invoice -> MedicalInvoice
purpose: P3.5 (NPDEV_PATH_A_REALIGNMENT_PLAN.md Phase 3 exit criterion): a pack-owned concept (invoicing::Invoice) specialized by the consuming app into MedicalInvoice, proving the whole specialization stack lands correctly in a generated app -- not just at the resolver/test level.
businessStory: A shared 'invoicing' pack ships a generic Invoice. A clinic app specializes it into MedicalInvoice: adding a doctorId field, tightening the positive-total rule, and locking the record read-only once billed, without copying Invoice's own implementation.
walkthrough: Confirm the DDL: MedicalInvoice's table carries id/code/total (inherited from Invoice) plus doctorId (its own).
Confirm the API: GET/POST against MedicalInvoice's CRUD endpoints work; a total <= 10 is refused by the overridden PositiveTotal invariant (base Invoice only refuses total <= 0).
Confirm the UI: the generated app's Box View shows MedicalInvoice specializing Invoice with the correct inherits/adds/changes lineage, and MedicalInvoice's own label reads 'Medical invoice'.
Confirm permissions: MedicalInvoice's access.write is 'false' (overridden), while the base Invoice's own access.write stays 'true'.
Prove regeneration survives: scripts/hygiene/check-deterministic-generation.ps1 -SampleId specialization-medical-invoice generates twice and diffs every emitted file.
expectedOutcomes: MedicalInvoice's generated table has exactly id, code, total, doctorId.
The overridden PositiveTotal invariant (total > 10) is enforced, not the base's (total > 0).
MedicalInvoice's access is read-only (write: false), overriding Invoice's read/write access.
Box View's Specializes column shows MedicalInvoice -> Invoice with the correct inherits/adds/changes lineage.
Two consecutive generations produce byte-identical output.
